description: Implementation of the Work class and related functionality for distributed operations in PyTorch, including handling of asynchronous work, futures, and profiling.

classes.name: Work
classes.description: Represents a unit of distributed work, supporting asynchronous operations, exception handling, and profiling.

classes.name: FutureWrappingWork
classes.description: A subclass of Work that wraps a c10::ivalue::Future, providing implementations for its interface.

methods.name: Work::Work
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Work object with optional profiling.

methods.name: Work::retrieveOpType
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the work.

methods.name: Work::isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the work is completed.

methods.name: Work::isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the work completed successfully.

methods.name: Work::exception
methods.description: Returns the exception pointer if the work failed.

methods.name: Work::sourceRank
methods.description: Method that should return the source rank; currently throws an error if called.

methods.name: Work::result
methods.description: Method to get the result of the work; currently not implemented.

methods.name: Work::synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the work, unregistering it if allowed.

methods.name: Work::wait
methods.description: Waits for the work to complete, with optional timeout.

methods.name: Work::blockCurrentStream
methods.description: Blocks the current CUDA stream until work is completed.

methods.name: Work::abort
methods.description: Method to abort the work; not implemented.

methods.name: Work::getFuture
methods.description: Returns the future associated with the work; not implemented.

methods.name: Work::getFutureResult
methods.description: Returns the future result; not implemented.

methods.name: Work::finish
methods.description: Marks the work as finished, handling exceptions and callbacks.

methods.name: Work::finishAndThrow
methods.description: Marks the work as finished and rethrows exceptions if any.

methods.name: Work::getDuration
methods.description: Method to get duration; not supported.

methods.name: Work::getSequencenumber
methods.description: Method to get sequence number; not supported.

methods.name: Work::create_from_future
methods.description: Creates a Work object from a future.
